run_note: Originally launched as a block-level fine-tuning test, but the same edit accidentally un-pinned training=False on the backbone call, letting BatchNorm update its statistics during Stage 2 instead of using frozen ImageNet moving stats. Since the block unfreeze depth (29 layers) is within 1 layer of the baseline layer-count scheme (30), this run is effectively an unintended ablation of BatchNorm mode, NOT a test of block-level fine-tuning. Renamed accordingly. Result: 72.30% test accuracy vs the baseline 73.73%.
